title: Three Kingdoms 7: The Battle of Red Cliffs  (Part One)

series.title: Three Kingdoms 7: The Battle of Red Cliffs  (Part One)

fullText.simplified:
第8章、草船

    鲁肃来见诸葛亮，他想看看诸葛亮是怎样用三天时间做十万枝箭的。但没想到，诸葛亮看到他来了，马上就说：“鲁大人，三天做不了十万枝箭，请你帮帮我！”
    鲁肃吃惊地问：“我怎么帮你？我也没办法啊！”
    诸葛亮说：“请你帮我找二十条船和六百个人，还要一些草和黑布。”
    鲁肃觉得奇怪极了：“船、草和黑布都不能做箭，你要这些东西做什么？”
    诸葛亮说：“答案我后天告诉你，现在请快点儿帮我准备这些东西吧。”
    鲁肃还是不明白，但诸葛亮不说，他也没办法，只好回去准备东西和人。下午他就准备好了，把人和东西送到了江边。诸葛亮很高兴，但他只在江边看了看，就回家喝茶去了。
    第一天，诸葛亮在家喝茶。第二天，诸葛亮还在家喝茶。
    鲁肃不明白，诸葛亮在想什么？他什么时候才开始做箭呢？鲁肃有点儿着急。
    终于到了第三天。
    早上，天还没亮，诸葛亮就请鲁肃去江边，说是去拿箭。
    鲁肃来到江边，看到诸葛亮坐在船上，就问：“十万枝箭都做好了？”
    诸葛亮点头。
    鲁肃问：“箭在哪儿呢？”
    诸葛亮笑着说：“不在这儿。你上船吧，我们一起去拿。”
    鲁肃上了船，看到船里有个小桌子，桌子上放着茶和杯子，诸葛亮坐在桌子旁喝着茶。鲁肃心想，诸葛亮怎么还有心情喝茶呢？他还记得保证书吗？今天拿不出十万枝箭，他就要死了啊！
    诸葛亮好像看出了他的担心，笑着说：“鲁大人别担心，箭已经做好了，我们现在就去拿。”说完，他让人开了船，鲁肃送给他的那二十条船也开了出来，每条船上都站着七八十个人。
    怎么有这么多人？鲁肃记得他只给了诸葛亮六百人，多的这些人是从哪儿来的？江上的雾很大，鲁肃走到船边看了一会儿，他看清楚了，然后笑了。原来船上的人里只有一半是真人，另一半是用草做的“草人”。黑色的布把船盖住了，布下面也放着草，草太多，船变成了“草船”。
    诸葛亮要用这些“草人”和“草船”做什么呢？船在往哪儿开？
    雾让鲁肃看不清方向，但他已经在船上了，他什么都不想问了。他坐了下来，和诸葛亮一起喝茶。
fullText.traditional:
第8章、草船

    魯肅來見諸葛亮，他想看看諸葛亮是怎樣用三天時間做十萬枝箭的。但沒想到，諸葛亮看到他來了，馬上就說：“魯大人，三天做不了十萬枝箭，請你幫幫我！”
    魯肅吃驚地問：“我怎麼幫你？我也沒辦法啊！”
    諸葛亮說：“請你幫我找二十條船和六百個人，還要一些草和黑布。”
    魯肅覺得奇怪極了：“船、草和黑布都不能做箭，你要這些東西做什麼？”
    諸葛亮說：“答案我後天告訴你，現在請快點兒幫我準備這些東西吧。”
    魯肅還是不明白，但諸葛亮不說，他也沒辦法，只好回去準備東西和人。下午他就準備好了，把人和東西送到了江邊。諸葛亮很高興，但他只在江邊看了看，就回家喝茶去了。
    第一天，諸葛亮在家喝茶。第二天，諸葛亮還在家喝茶。
    魯肅不明白，諸葛亮在想什麼？他什麼時候才開始做箭呢？魯肅有點兒著急。
    終於到了第三天。
    早上，天還沒亮，諸葛亮就請魯肅去江邊，說是去拿箭。
    魯肅來到江邊，看到諸葛亮坐在船上，就問：“十萬枝箭都做好了？”
    諸葛亮點頭。
    魯肅問：“箭在哪兒呢？”
    諸葛亮笑著說：“不在這兒。你上船吧，我們一起去拿。”
    魯肅上了船，看到船裡有個小桌子，桌子上放著茶和杯子，諸葛亮坐在桌子旁喝著茶。魯肅心想，諸葛亮怎麼還有心情喝茶呢？他還記得保證書嗎？今天拿不出十萬枝箭，他就要死了啊！
    諸葛亮好像看出了他的擔心，笑著說：“魯大人別擔心，箭已經做好了，我們現在就去拿。”說完，他讓人開了船，魯肅送給他的那二十條船也開了出來，每條船上都站著七八十個人。
    怎麼有這麼多人？魯肅記得他只給了諸葛亮六百人，多的這些人是從哪兒來的？江上的霧很大，魯肅走到船邊看了一會兒，他看清楚了，然後笑了。原來船上的人裡只有一半是真人，另一半是用草做的“草人”。黑色的布把船蓋住了，布下面也放著草，草太多，船變成了“草船”。
    諸葛亮要用這些“草人”和“草船”做什麼呢？船在往哪兒開？
    霧讓魯肅看不清方向，但他已經在船上了，他什麼都不想問了。他坐了下來，和諸葛亮一起喝茶。

sentences.traditional: 草太多，船變成了“草船”。
sentences.pinyin: cǎo tài duō chuán biàn chéng le cǎo chuán
sentences.english: There was so much straw that the boats became “straw boats”.

sentences.simplified: 诸葛亮要用这些“草人”和“草船”做什么呢？船在往哪儿开？
sentences.traditional: 諸葛亮要用這些“草人”和“草船”做什麼呢？船在往哪兒開？
sentences.pinyin: zhū gě liàng yào yòng zhè xiē cǎo rén hé cǎo chuán zuò shén me ne chuán zài wǎng nǎ'r kāi
sentences.english: What did Zhuge Liang want to do with these “straw men” and “straw boats”? Where were the boats heading?

sentences.simplified: 雾让鲁肃看不清方向，但他已经在船上了，他什么都不想问了。
sentences.traditional: 霧讓魯肅看不清方向，但他已經在船上了，他什麼都不想問了。
sentences.pinyin: wù ràng lǔ sù kàn bù qīng fāng xiàng dàn tā yǐ jīng zài chuán shang le tā shén me dōu bù xiǎng wèn le
sentences.english: The fog made it hard for Lu Su to see where they were going, but he was already on the boat, so he didn’t want to ask any questions.

sentences.simplified: 他坐了下来，和诸葛亮一起喝茶。
sentences.traditional: 他坐了下來，和諸葛亮一起喝茶。
sentences.pinyin: tā zuò le xià lái hé zhū gě liàng yì qǐ hē chá
sentences.english: He sat down and drank tea with Zhuge Liang.

sentence_translations: Chapter 8: Straw Boats
Lu Su went to see Zhuge Liang. He wanted to see how Zhuge Liang would make 100,000 arrows in three days.
But to his surprise, when Zhuge Liang saw Lu Su coming, he immediately said, ..
.. “Lord Lu, it’s impossible to make 100,000 arrows in three days! Please help me!”
Lu Su was taken aback and asked, “How could I help you? I have no way of doing that either!”
Zhuge Liang said, “Please help me find 20 boats and 600 men, and also some straw and black cloth.”
Lu Su found that very strange:
“You can’t make arrows with boats, straw, and black cloth. What do you need these things for?”
Zhuge Liang said, “I’ll tell you the answer the day after tomorrow. Now please hurry up and help me get these things ready.”
Lu Su still didn’t understand, but Zhuge Liang wasn’t talking.
He had no choice. He had to go and prepare the things and the men.
In the afternoon, Lu Su was ready to send the men and the things to the river.
Zhuge Liang was very happy. But he just had a look from the side of the river and then went home to drink tea.
On the first day, Zhuge Liang was at home drinking tea. The next day, Zhuge Liang was still at home drinking tea.
Lu Su did not understand what Zhuge Liang was thinking. When would he start making arrows? Lu Su was a little anxious.
Finally, it was the third day.
In the morning, before dawn, Zhuge Liang asked Lu Su to go to the river, saying that it was to get the arrows.
When Lu Su came to the riverside and saw Zhuge Liang sitting on a boat, he asked, “Are the 100,000 arrows all ready?”
Zhuge Liang nodded his head.
Lu Su asked, “Where are the arrows?”
Zhuge Liang smiled and said, “Not here. Come on board, and we’ll go get them together.”
Lu Su got on board and saw that there was a small table on the boat. The table had tea and cups on it.
Zhuge Liang sat at the table drinking tea. Lu Su thought to himself: How can Zhuge Liang still be in the mood for tea?
Does he remember the pledge? If he can’t get 100,000 arrows today, he’s going to die!”
Zhuge Liang seemed to notice that he was worried and said with a smile, ..
.. “Don’t worry, Lord Lu, the arrows are ready. We’ll go get them now.”
After he said that, Zhuge Liang had their boat set sail.
The 20 boats that Lu Su had given him also sailed set sail, with 70 or 80 men standing on each one.
How could there be so many men?
Lu Su remembered that he only gave Zhuge Liang 600 men. Where did the other men come from?
It was very foggy on the river. Lu Su walked to the side of the boat and just looked for a while.
When he could see clearly, he smiled.
It turned out that only half of the men on board were real people. The other half were “straw men” made of straw.
Black cloth covered the boats, and straw was placed under the cloth.
There was so much straw that the boats became “straw boats”.
What did Zhuge Liang want to do with these “straw men” and “straw boats”? Where were the boats heading?
The fog made it hard for Lu Su to see where they were going, but he was already on the boat, so he didn’t want to ask any questions.
He sat down and drank tea with Zhuge Liang.
